Attack Shark CM03 Rainbow Coated eSport Gaming Mouse Pad (450 x 400 mm / Speed Cloth Layout)

Elevate your competitive tracking precision and gaming setup aesthetic with the Attack Shark CM03 Rainbow Coated eSport gaming mouse pad, brought to you by Turbo Computer Egypt. Specifically engineered for pro-grade esports performance, this premium speed cloth pad utilizes an ultra-fine microfiber surface coated with a specialized rainbow protective layer that dynamically shifts colors depending on light angles. Delivering an incredibly smooth glide that is 1.5 times softer than standard cloth meshes, it provides a perfect balance of micro-control and high-speed flicking accuracy. Crafted with a spacious 450x400mm surface architecture and a comfortable 4mm thickness profile, it features a water and stain-resistant treatment for effortless cleanup alongside tightly stitched anti-fraying borders. Supported by a high-density natural rubber base configuration, it remains perfectly locked on your desk setup.
